The '''harvester beetle''' was a beetle native to [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], but was settled on all of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]]. They were five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, had cutting jaws, three pairs of [[Limb/Legends|legs]], flat heads, and were able to carry up to five times their body weight on their swept backs. Their heads had a pair of looped feelers which served as both feelers and [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromonal]] communicators.

They, along with [[Manax tree/Legends|manax trees]], were an integral source of the [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] that gave the Neimoidians their riches. The Neimoidians tamed the beetles, which were separated into castes: laborers, harvesters, soldiers, and breeders. At the height of the harvester beetle hierarchy was a queen, who controlled what the other hive members ate.
